parameters.content: ## RAG Knowledge Assistant v0.1.0 (stub core — offline, deterministic)\nLocal retrieval-grounded API: a webhook receives a query, a DETERMINISTIC stub embeds it (token-overlap, no model) and retrieves over an IN-REPO corpus (fixtures/corpus/*), then a THRESHOLD GATE routes to either a GROUNDED ANSWER with citations (every cited chunkId in retrieval.topK; the quote is a real span of its chunk) or a CLEAN ABSTAIN (abstained:true, answer:null, citations:[] — the controlled failure mode). CITATION-INTEGRITY is enforced deterministically (a cited chunk outside the retrieved set -> passed=false). A redacted audit event (ids + scores + verdicts only — no raw query/answer/chunk text) is emitted, then a structured JSON response per the eval-plan scorer contract (abstained, answer, citations, retrieval{topK,maxScore,threshold}, retrievalSource, generationSource, passed, policyVersion rag-knowledge-assistant-v0.1.0). retrievalSource/generationSource are NORMALIZED ("supabase"/"ollama" accepted) but DEGRADE TO STUB this phase, so CI can never hit a live backend. DEFERRED to Phase 2b: live Supabase pgvector retrieval + live Ollama embeddings/generation behind these same gates. Manual trigger runs an editor demo (an in-corpus grounded answer); the webhook serves the API. Mirrors the sibling eval-harness stub-default discipline.
